map.算例（标题A 展示3000/点击120，标题B 展示3000/点击210）: Example (title A: 3000 impressions / 120 clicks; title B: 3000 impressions / 210 clicks)

map.标题测试要注意什么？: What Should I Watch Out For When Testing Titles?
map.两版展示量应尽量一致（本例都 3000）才有可比性；样本太小（几十次曝光）时 C: Impressions should be as equal as possible (3000 each here) for comparability; with tiny samples (a few dozen impressions) CTR fluctuates wildly, so accumulate data before judging. Relative lift is steadier than the absolute difference.
map.什么样的标题 CTR 高？: What Titles Get a High CTR?
map.经验上含具体数字（如「3个方法」）、情感/悬念词（如「绝了」「竟然」）、明确利益: Empirically, titles with concrete numbers (like "3 methods"), emotional or suspense words, and a clear benefit are clicked more; but excessive clickbaiting gets throttled by platforms, so appeal and honesty must be balanced.
